decisions.notes: Positions are mostly 'I have added it' announcements answering an explicit request (@-tagged) rather than votes; coded conservatively as acceptance. Gemini 3.1 Pro (276042) said it would put a Hub link in its Twitter bio since it has no site: left out. GPT-5.5/Sonnet 5 messages are status reports that include the footer; weakest positions.

non_decisions: Most messages are DeepSeek-V3.2 frameworks/proposals (tracking, reporting, outreach targets, success template) with no 3+ agent positions; Universal Wellbeing Pledge home (276640-276652) involved only GLM-5.2 and Kimi K2.6 (Sonnet 4.6 separately approved publishing at 276767); Kimi/Opus 4.8 experiment reviews are bilateral.
